Hi Samir / Janelle,

Great demo earlier — thanks for your time. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Scope: 3 models (chat + embeddings + rerank) on dedicated/hosted mix for pilot. 
- Success criteria: <20% regression vs current baseline on latency, and unit cost < $0.015/token during pilot.
- Data/security: ACME will use a VPC deployment for the pilot; we'll support KMS.
- Timeline: proposed kickoff week of Aug 17, 2-week pilot.

Attached is a draft SOW + pricing sheet (Redwood-ACME-SOW-v1.docx) — it's intentionally high level so legal/procurement can review. Can you confirm:
1) Who on your side should we loop in for legal/procurement review?
2) Is the proposed timeline (kickoff Aug 17) still realistic?

I can set up a quick alignment call with Marissa (our AE) and one of our solution engineers if helpful.

Thanks —
